results.name: shop/worker

error.Text: Deployment shop/worker has 1 replicas but 0 are available with status running

results.details:
Error: The deployment "worker" in namespace "shop" expects 1 pod to run, but none are currently running.

Solution: 1) Check pod status: kubectl get pods -n shop 2) View pod logs: kubectl logs <pod-name> -n shop 3) Describe pod: kubectl describe pod <pod-name> -n shop 4) Fix issues found (image, resources, etc.)

results.name: shop/worker-86f68b9bf6-dvxbd

error.Text: the termination reason is OOMKilled exitCode=137 container=worker pod=worker-86f68b9bf6-dvxbd

results.details:
Error: The container ran out of memory (RAM) and was killed by Kubernetes.

Solution:
1. Increase memory limit in deployment YAML
2. Add: resources.limits.memory (e.g., "2Gi")
3. Apply: kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml
4. Monitor: kubectl top pod worker-*
